plan_a_advantages: Includes longer, more substantial aerobic runs.
Introduces a wider range of aerobic duration (58 min to 70 min).

reasoning: Plan A is the better training plan for a trail runner aiming to become faster. It incorporates longer, sustained aerobic runs (58 min, 70 min) which are crucial for building the endurance necessary for trail racing. Plan B, conversely, consists almost entirely of very short, easy runs, offering minimal stimulus for improvement. While Plan B prioritizes recovery, it lacks the volume and intensity needed to develop the aerobic capacity required for faster trail running. Plan A’s structure allows for a gradual increase in aerobic base, a key component of improving speed.
